From the field to your screen
Measured First, a field station takes its reading and sends it over MQTT to AWS IoT Core.
Queued Then it waits in a queue, where repeats of the same message are dropped.
Checked Next it is range-checked, corrected by its calibration and stored, raw value kept.
Predicted Then an AI model forecasts the next readings and flags any that surprise it.
Shown Last, this page asks for it again every 5 seconds.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (6 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (6.2:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 212 characters per line.
This page is served by a development server (Vite, webpack or Next in dev mode).
findings.fix: Run the last gate on the production build too (vite build && vite preview, next build && next start, or the built index.html): minifiers and bundlers change the CSS a visitor receives.
Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.
